name: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V.
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-18), cover page: securities registered under Section 12(b) are 'Ordinary Shares, nominal value EUR 3.50 per share', trading symbol MICC on the New York Stock Exchange; admission announcement 8 December 2025: issued share capital on admission was 612,259,739 ordinary shares admitted to trading on Euronext Amsterdam, the London Stock Exchange and the NYSE, with DTC accounts credited with interests in TMICC ordinary shares — the NYSE security is the ordinary share itself
ads_ratio.reason: MICC is a direct multi-listing of ordinary shares, not an ADS program: one NYSE-traded MICC share is one ordinary share (the 612,259,739 issued ordinary shares match the DEI outstanding count in dcf_numbers.json), so per-share figures from the 20-F are directly comparable to the traded price with no scaling.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-18), EPS note (Annual Report p.115): average number of shares 612.3M basic, plus 3.3M dilutive effect of share-based compensation plans = 615.6M diluted average for 2025; the note states the 2025 average equals the shares outstanding at 31 December 2025 and that no EPS was calculated for prior years
overrides_applied.reason: Demerger pro-forma denominator. The 20-F states: 'Prior to 6 December 2025, the Group was under the control of Unilever and did not have any issued shares. Accordingly, EPS has not been calculated for prior years.' FY2023-24 are combined carve-out years with no filed diluted share count under any tag (DATA_GAP:shares). The only diluted count the filer has ever filed — 615.6M, the count created at the demerger (612,259,739 ordinary shares issued 6-7 Dec 2025) — is applied to the two missing carve-out years so per-share OE is stated on the capital structure that exists now. Kind is estimate (not filing) because the value is filed for 2025, not for the missing periods; it anchors exactly on the last filed diluted value (615.6M, 1.00x — inside the 0.1x-10x band).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency EUR converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-18), cover page: securities registered under Section 12(b) are 'Ordinary Shares, nominal value EUR 3.50 per share', trading symbol MICC on the New York Stock Exchange; admission announcement 8 December 2025: issued share capital on admission was 612,259,739 ordinary shares admitted to trading on Euronext Amsterdam, the London Stock Exchange and the NYSE, with DTC accounts credited with interests in TMICC ordinary shares — the NYSE security is the ordinary share itself) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
THIN_HISTORY: only 3 fiscal years of data

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (estimate: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-18), EPS note (Annual Report p.115): average number of shares 612.3M basic, plus 3.3M dilutive effect of share-based compensation plans = 615.6M diluted average for 2025; the note states the 2025 average equals the shares outstanding at 31 December 2025 and that no EPS was calculated for prior years); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 0.17 vs 3-yr median 1.11 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (7.3%) vs bull-case tier C (10.8%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
